# Kodi Reader 0.4.10
- Listen with a new audio player designed for Kodi, including chapter progress, 15-second skips, playback speed, narrator selection, and optional text following. Narration continues into the next chapter. - Select a passage and choose **Listen from Here** to start listening at that passage and continue through the book. - Follow footnotes, citations, and other EPUB references, then use **Back to reading** to return to your original passage. Nested references return one step at a time, even after changing the font, window size, or column layout. - Pause narration automatically when following a reference. Audio stays paused during the detour and after returning, including when speech is still buffering, until you press Play. - Keep spoken passages distinct with a subtle underline that works alongside saved highlights and text selection. Avoid coloring ordinary text as links. - Keep page turns aligned when scrolling rapidly, and preserve your passage when opening or closing the audio player.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. Includes iCloud and Google Drive sync support. Narration is available for English EPUBs and runs on your Mac after the optional voice files have downloaded.

# Kodi Reader 0.4.9
- Record audio notes alongside your highlights and text notes. Pause, resume, play back, rename, export, and manage recordings from the note editor. - Listen to selected passages or the rest of the current English EPUB chapter with on-device read aloud, and transcribe audio notes locally. Optional voice files and speech-model setup happen when you use these features. - Save research reminders tied to passages or pages, return to their notes, and keep reminders and audio attachments with your optional library sync. - Search, sort, and filter your library more easily, including sorting by the date a document was added. - Improve reader engagement analytics, meaningful note and drawing counts, Ask AI outcomes, and approximate connection-country reporting. A one-time notice and Settings → Privacy make usage sharing easy to turn off. Book text, note content, drawings, recordings, transcripts, and AI content are excluded from analytics. - Keep note-sheet activity in engagement time, ignore idle time and canvas navigation, and avoid inflating feature counts with repeated autosaves. - Keep deliberate page turns when closing or resizing the notes sidebar. - Refine note editing, exports, syncing, and passage selection. The standalone web browser has been removed; existing saved web documents remain readable.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. Includes iCloud and Google Drive sync support. Update Kodi on every Mac before managing reminders and audio attachments across devices. Local audio models require a separate download.

# Kodi Reader 0.4.8
- Set a daily reading goal in Settings → Reading. Your goal and streak stay in Settings by default; turn on Show reading goal and streak to display them on Home and in the reader toolbar. Reading history stays on this Mac and works with usage analytics turned off. - Keep highlight actions inside the reading area, including in narrow windows and near the bottom of a page. Clear plain highlights or delete annotations with notes and drawings using clearer action labels. - Place reading markers more reliably around wrapped and hyphenated text, line beginnings, and column boundaries. - Share limited usage analytics, with a new Settings → Privacy control to turn sharing off and clear unsent events. Book content, notes, account details, and AI questions and answers are excluded. - Improve cleanup of duplicate Kodi Reader and legacy Folio entries in Finder's Open With menu, including development builds and failed packaging outputs. - Open Reading, Privacy, and Updates settings without first looking up Google Drive credentials.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. Includes iCloud and Google Drive sync support.
